content.json: Note for this workbook: Data can lag by up to ~10 minutes due to workflow processing and Azure ingestion. If you need the earliest possible view, set Time range to Last 30 minutes; otherwise the default is Last hour.

content.query:
let ip = trim(@' ', '{AppIp}');
let Filtered = materialize(
  Syslog
  | where (isempty(ip) or HostIP == ip or SyslogMessage has ip)
  | where SyslogMessage has "Passwordstate"
  | extend Outcome = extract(@"Passwordstate:\s+([A-Za-z]+)", 1, SyslogMessage)
  | extend AuthMethod = extract(@"'([A-Za-z0-9\-_]+)'\s+login", 1, SyslogMessage)
  | extend UserID = extract(@"UserID\s+'([^']+)'", 1, SyslogMessage)
  | extend NameID = extract(@"SAMLNameID'\s+of\s+'([^']+)'", 1, SyslogMessage)
  | extend SrcIP = extract(@"IP Address\s+'([0-9\.]+)'", 1, SyslogMessage)
  | extend ClientIP = coalesce(
      extract(@"Client IP Address\s*=\s*([0-9\.]+)", 1, SyslogMessage),
      extract(@"ClientIP[:=]\s*([0-9\.]+)", 1, SyslogMessage),
      SrcIP)
);
Filtered
| summarize Count = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
content.title: Passwordstate Syslog — Volume over time

content.query:

Syslog
| where (isempty(ip) or HostIP == ip or SyslogMessage has ip)
| where SyslogMessage has "Passwordstate"
| extend SrcIP = extract(@"IP Address\s+'([0-9\.]+)'", 1, SyslogMessage)

content.query:
let ip = trim(@' ', '{AppIp}');
let Data = Syslog
| where (isempty(ip) or HostIP == ip or SyslogMessage has ip)
| where SyslogMessage has "Passwordstate"
| extend Outcome = extract(@"Passwordstate:\s+([A-Za-z]+)", 1, SyslogMessage)
| extend AuthMethod = extract(@"'([A-Za-z0-9\-_]+)'\s+login", 1, SyslogMessage)
| extend UserID = extract(@"UserID\s+'([^']+)'", 1, SyslogMessage)
| extend NameID = extract(@"SAMLNameID'\s+of\s+'([^']+)'", 1, SyslogMessage)
| extend SrcIP = extract(@"IP Address\s+'([0-9\.]+)'", 1, SyslogMessage)
| extend ClientIP = coalesce(
    extract(@"Client IP Address\s*=\s*([0-9\.]+)", 1, SyslogMessage),
    extract(@"ClientIP[:=]\s*([0-9\.]+)", 1, SyslogMessage),
    SrcIP);
Data
| where Outcome =~ "Successful"
| project TimeGenerated, Outcome, AuthMethod, UserID, NameID, ClientIP, Computer, SeverityLevel, SyslogMessage
| order by TimeGenerated desc
